text.en: Data2vec is row 33 of the BenchCouncil AI100 (2022-2023) annual table in the Multimodal area.
text.zh: Data2vec 是 BenchCouncil AI100（2022-2023）年度表第 33 行，所属领域为“多模态”。

text.en: The annual table associates Data2vec with “Data2vec: A General Framework for Self-supervised Learning in Speech, Vision and Language”.
text.zh: 年度表把 Data2vec 与论文《Data2vec: A General Framework for Self-supervised Learning in Speech, Vision and Language》关联。

text.en: The Main Contributors field is “Alexei Baevski, Michael Auli”.
text.zh: “主要人物”字段依次列出 Alexei Baevski（官方页拼写）、Michael Auli（官方页拼写）；官方英文原文为“Alexei Baevski, Michael Auli”。
